name: 5dive-a2a
description: The 5dive a2a plugin (the `5dive a2a` verb, also `5dive peer`): agents on different boxes message each other directly, signed per OpenAgent RFC 0001.

plugins.name: a2a
plugins.description: Agents on different boxes message each other directly. Each message is signed with the sending agent's did:key, checked against the receiver's contact list, and delivered to the agent when it is idle. Strangers get nothing.
